breakthroughs.insight: Monotonic Stack — store INDEX not tuple. Update the POPPED element's answer.
BFS level separation — snapshot len(queue) BEFORE the inner loop, not during.
Multi-source BFS — start BFS from ALL '1' cells simultaneously for 01 Matrix.
